recipes.name: Vanilla Chia Pudding with Mixed Fruit
instructions: In a large bowl or jar, combine the milk, chia seeds, mango, strawberries, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Let sit for 5 to 10 minutes and then stir to redistribute the settled seeds.
Cover and chill in the fridge overnight.
Stir well before serving. Add some granola for crunch, or some more fresh fruit on top, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Store in the fridge for up to 3 days. Add the fruit and granola before serving.
